name: Lakota Windsong
summary: At Darkcloud Pinnacle, Lakota Windsong waits under Grimtotem guard. Arnak Grimtotem took her after she refused his proposal.

sections.title: A Deadly Courtship
sections.body: Not long after the Third War, Arnak Grimtotem began courting Lakota Windsong. She refused him and would not join his clan, but Arnak would not accept her answer. Under cover of night, he returned and killed Lakota's brother when he tried to stop him. Then Arnak carried Lakota into the jagged heights of Thousand Needles. Now she is held high above the canyon floor at Darkcloud Pinnacle, under heavy guard. Arnak still insists she will be his bride.

sections.title: Descent to Safety
sections.body: Grimtotem bandits surround Lakota, and she cannot descend the cliffs alone. An escort must guide her across the suspension bridges and down the winding paths to the canyon basin. From the base of Darkcloud Pinnacle, Lakota flees toward Freewind Post. There she tells Thalia Amberhide and the defenders at the post of her rescue.

faq.q: Why is Lakota Windsong being held at Darkcloud Pinnacle?
aliases: why is lakota in darkcloud pinnacle
faq.answer: Lakota is held at Darkcloud Pinnacle because she refused Arnak Grimtotem's marriage proposal. He killed her brother and abducted her to the Grimtotem stronghold, hoping to force her hand.

faq.q: Where does Lakota go once she is rescued?
aliases: where does she go after escort
faq.answer: After reaching the base of Darkcloud Pinnacle, Lakota makes her way to Freewind Post. There she finds refuge among the Horde defenders and reports her ordeal to Thalia Amberhide.
Arnak Grimtotem is a violent warrior of the treacherous Grimtotem clan. When Lakota refused to marry him, he murdered her brother and abducted her.

angles.text: As a tauren, you see the Grimtotem's treachery and their defiance of Cairne Bloodhoof's leadership, which often turns violent.
As a member of the Horde, you strike a blow against Grimtotem dominance over Thousand Needles when you rescue Lakota. You also help keep the way safe for travelers resting at Freewind Post.
